findings.title: Flex layout disables the action button's right float
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container turns its direct children into flex items, and `float: right` on the button no longer positions it at the right edge. Since `.small-action-desc` also has no flex-grow or other rule to consume the remaining space, the button will sit immediately after the description instead of remaining right-aligned as before. Give the description a growing flex value or push the button with `margin-left: auto`.
